name: daily-aeo-report
description: Generate and deliver daily AEO analytics report to Discord

preExec.description: Build AEO report from query logs, knowledge base stats, and discovery pipeline, then send to Discord

instructions: If query volume increased significantly, note the trend.
If low-confidence queries appear, these are content gaps — flag for new article ideas.
If stale content is flagged, consider refreshing those articles.
If discovery pipeline has pending items, the structuring pipeline may need attention.
